Ojo Zoom is a fork of Ojo with extra features:
• pinch-to-zoom and double tap zoom on a fullscreen camera, drag to pan, back resets the zoom
• swipe left or right on a fullscreen camera (not zoomed) to show the next or previous camera
• in portrait the cameras are shown one under the other, scroll to see them all (unless "Landscape only" is set)
• snapshots (Pictures/OjoZoom) and recordings (Movies/OjoZoom): long press a fullscreen camera, or long press OK on the remote, to show the buttons. Recordings stop by themselves after the max length set in the settings or when storage gets low
• the settings button is hidden while cameras are shown: long press (1.5 s) anywhere in the grid, or any remote key on Android TV, shows it for 5 seconds
